description: A company's share buybacks period by period from its own XBRL (SEC company facts): for each fiscal year or quarter, the cash paid for repurchases, the shares bought and the value recorded for them, the average price, the program's authorized and remaining amounts where tagged, and the change in shares outstanding. Each figure names the filing it came from (accession, form, date); a figure the company does not tag is said to be untagged, not estimated.

periods.description: Periods to show, newest first; default 10 years or 8 quarters.

quarterly.description: Fiscal quarters instead of fiscal years; default false.

name: buybacks

outputSchema.description: rows are fiscal years or quarters, newest first, in the order of columns; average_price is value_repurchased over shares_repurchased; filing is the report behind a row's figures, from names any taken elsewhere, and filings gives each report's form, date and link.

title: Share buybacks, authorized and bought
